images.caption: Dendy Street Beach and Middle Brighton Beach on a summer's afternoon, featuring the Melbourne tourist icon of the Brighton Bathing Boxes. In the background can be seen the Middle Brighton Baths, the Middle Brighton Pier and Breakwater, and boats of the Royal Brighton Yacht Club. In the far distance is the Melbourne City skyline, some 12km away. Brighton, Victoria, Australia.
